## Additional Features - **Ocean Foundations** — An ocean bathymetry layer is included, providing depth-colored ocean floor tiles for open-water areas and coastal lagoons. - **Neighborhood Labels** — The map includes curated municipal, superblock (*supermanzana*), and neighborhood labels derived from administrative census and OpenStreetMap boundary data. ## Demographics & Calibration Demographic and employment distribution is calibrated using microdata from the Mexican National Institute of Statistics and Geography (INEGI) 2020 Population and Housing Census (`RESAGEBURB`) down to individual urban blocks (*manzanas*), synchronized with CONAPO official municipal demographic projections. Commercial mass, employment nodes, and service clusters are integrated from the contemporary National Directory of Economic Units (DENUE) and ENOE economic activity indicators (tasa PEA 66.5%). Commuting trips are synthesized using a double-constrained Furness entropy gravity model with strict mass conservation ($\sum T_{ij} \equiv \sum \text{PEA}_i$), while vehicular travel baselines follow canonical free-flow routing (~40 km/h) derived via Open Source Routing Machine (OSRM). ## Reference Sources - **INEGI:** Censo de Población y Vivienda 2020 (CPV - Microdatos por Manzana Urbana `RESAGEBURB`) - **INEGI:** Directorio Estadístico Nacional de Unidades Económicas (DENUE 2024–2026) - **INEGI:** Encuesta Nacional de Ocupación y Empleo (ENOE Quintana Roo) - **CONAPO:** Proyecciones de la Población de los Municipios de México 2020–2070 - **OpenStreetMap & Geofabrik:** Road geometry, 3D building outlines, and natural waterways - **ASUR & SECTUR:** Cancun and Cozumel Airport passenger movements and hotel zone capacities ## License Open Database License (ODbL) for underlying OpenStreetMap data; INEGI & CONAPO open data terms of use. ## Credits - **Map Author:** Meszier83 - **Cartographic Data:** © [OpenStreetMap](https://www.openstreetmap.org/) contributors, [Geofabrik GmbH](https://download.geofabrik.de/). - **Demographic & Statistical Modeling:** Instituto Nacional de Estadística y Geografía ([INEGI](https://www.inegi.org.mx/)) & Consejo Nacional de Población ([CONAPO](https://www.gob.mx/conapo)). - **Routing Engine:** Open Source Routing Machine ([OSRM](http://project-osrm.org/)).
